assign.outcome:
**Miller columns landed — nested pages laying out as equal peers**, the fifteenth Page demo (Arrangements). Every page in the tree is a column; click a row and the next opens to its right; click further left and everything right of it closes; below two columns' width the row pages one at a time; six deep it scrolls sideways and the newest column scrolls itself into view. The DOM stays a tree (each page's `$pages` region inside its own view — the visibility contract and demo.app's `mark()` untouched); `display: contents` flattens only the layout. Measured headless: 390 → 3 × 329 one at a time; 1280 → 3 × 195, six deep 6 × 180 scrolling; 3440 → 3 × 432 at the 24em cap; every visible column the same width and height at every step; zero console errors.
